name: Cell ↔ Environment — Live Coupling
description: Fig 4 as a fully runnable temporal study: a real length-9 diffusing chemical grid seeded as a nutrient GRADIENT (low at index 0, high at index 8). The single cell sits at an interior index (4) and senses its LOCAL field through one typed interface — driving uptake (→mass growth), traction, and up-gradient chemotactic drift, writing uptake/traction back to the shared environment. This is the demonstration behind Fig 4b: the environment's fields DRIVE the cell's interface ports. Runnable (default_n_steps + RAMEmitter); the seeded gradient is what drives the cell (the source is off, so diffusion only relaxes it slowly).
